newsitem.title: Australia: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 5.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).

Australian Foundation Investment Company Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Advent Limited on 31/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 1,103,000 ordinary shares (5.00%).

Equitilink Australia Ltd, Laurence Stephen Freedman, and Brian Michael Sherman decreased their relevant interest in Spectrum Network Systems Limited on 23/01/1997, from 6,198,434 ordinary shares (8.82%) to 5,531,084 ordinary shares (6.78%).
Greenchip Opportunities Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Ballarat Consolidated Gold Limited on 01/04/1996.
Templeton World Wide Inc decreased its relevant interest in National Foods Limited on 30/01/1997, from 23,408,030 ordinary shares (9.26%) to 21,688,656 ordinary shares (8.01%).
Devex Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Carnarvon Petroleum NL on 31/01/1997.
Mr Keith Knowles increased its relevant interest in Airboss Limited on 31/01/1997, from 22,023,529 ordinary shares (13.29%) to 25,139,407 ordinary shares (14.31%).

Westpac Investment Management Pty Limited became a substantial shareholder in Australian Provincial Newspapers Holdings Limited on 31/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 11,914,528 ordinary shares (5.17%).
Tennscourt Oil Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Allstate Explorations NL ALX,AX on 31/01/1997, from 1,458,255 ordinary shares (5.00%) to 2,562,846 ordinary shares (6.29%).
Otter Gold Mines Ltd increased its relevant interest in Allstate Explorations NL on 29/01/1997, from 17,183,639 ordinary shares (51.87%) to 19,903,575 ordinary shares (48.90%).
FAI General Insurance Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Formida Holdings Limited on 31/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 453,575 ordinary shares (5.10%).
BLE Capital Limited decreased its relevant interest in Biron Corporation Limited on 03/02/1997, from 2,032,510 ordinary shares (9.33%) to 1,486,810 ordinary shares (6.76%).
Koy Pty Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Western Reefs Limited on 31/01/1997, from 5,097,995 ordinary shares (22.1%) to 5,733,995 ordinary shares (21.35%).
